name: RIG-I-like receptor signalling to type I interferon production
rationale: All members concern cytosolic RNA-virus sensing via RIG-I/MDA5-TRAF-IRF/NF-kB signalling; unlike its confusables the theme carries positive regulation of IFN-alpha/beta production and the antiviral IFN signature.

core: Lymphocyte antigen receptor signalling and co-receptor regulation
qualifier: spanning both T and B cell receptors
name: T and B cell antigen receptor signalling and co-receptor regulation
rationale: Members cover TCR/BCR proximal signalling and CD28/CTLA4/BTLA/CD22 co-stimulation or co-inhibition; the B cell receptor members distinguish it from the T-cell-only confusables.

core: Motor system development and motor behaviour
name: Cerebellar and nigrostriatal development and motor behaviour
rationale: Members span cerebellar layer/Bergmann glia/granule precursor development, substantia nigra and striatum development, and locomotion, proprioception and motor learning; the confusables instead carry brainstem, pons and respiratory-control members.

name: Regulation of ribosome biogenesis and MYC target genes
rationale: Members concern nucleolar control of rRNA transcription and ribosome biogenesis plus MYC targets; confusables carry the Pol I initiation machinery itself rather than MYC targets and ribosome-biogenesis regulation.

core: Proteasomal degradation in MHC class I antigen handling
qualifier: HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of immune receptors
name: Proteasome function and HIV Nef/Vpu downregulation of immune receptors
rationale: Members are proteasome assembly/degradation, MHC class I antigen processing and Nef/Vpu-driven loss of CD4, CD8, CD28 and MHC-I; the Nef/Vpu and proteasome members distinguish it from antigen-presentation confusables.

name: Glial differentiation and proliferation including astrocyte reactivity
rationale: All members regulate oligodendrocyte, astrocyte or Schwann cell fate, proliferation, migration or survival; astrocyte activation/migration and glial fate specification set it apart from the myelin-focused confusables.

name: Embryonic craniofacial and limb morphogenesis
rationale: Members are face, palate, nose, neurocranium/viscerocranium and limb/digit morphogenesis with mesenchymal development; confusables instead hold pharyngeal organ or ossification members.

qualifier: by RNA polymerases II and III
name: snRNA gene transcription by RNA polymerases II and III
rationale: Members cover Pol II and Pol III (type 3 promoter) snRNA transcription with Pol III elongation/termination and U4/U6 snRNP formation; confusables are splicing or tRNA-type Pol III transcription.

core: Post-transcriptional mRNA stability and translation control
name: mRNA stability and translation control with stress granule dynamics
rationale: Members are RNA-binding-protein control of mRNA stability, localisation and translation; stress granule assembly/disassembly, PKR and arsenite response distinguish it from the AU-rich decay confusables.

name: Cardiac contractility and stress-induced striated muscle hypertrophy
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation together with cardiac adaptation, sarcomere organisation and hypertrophy; the hypertrophy/adaptation members separate it from calcium-handling and negative-contraction confusables.

name: Cation-chloride cotransport, osmoregulation and epithelial chloride transport
rationale: Members concern Na/K/Cl cotransporter disorders, renal salt transport and cellular osmotic/volume responses; epithelial chloride exchange, Ca-activated K channels and paracellular transport distinguish it from confusables.

name: ER membrane protein insertion and COPII export to Golgi
rationale: Members are SRP/tail-anchored/multipass insertion into the ER and COPII cargo loading toward Golgi; confusables instead carry COPI retrograde traffic, ER folding/ERAD or connexin transport.

core: Nuclear pore complex assembly and transport
name: Nuclear pore complex assembly and inositol phosphate nucleocytoplasmic transport
rationale: Members are NPC assembly, disassembly and localisation plus transport of inositol phosphates and Rev through the pore; confusables carry nuclear envelope breakdown or mRNA/ribosome export.

name: Peroxisomal fatty acid metabolism and sterol isoprenoid biosynthesis
rationale: Members span peroxisome biogenesis, very-long-chain/ether lipid metabolism and mevalonate-to-cholesterol synthesis; the cholesterol/isoprenoid members distinguish it from the purely fatty acid oxidation confusables.

core: T cell adhesion and immunological synapse formation
name: T cell polarity, immunological synapse and chemokine-directed migration
rationale: Members are T cell polarisation, raft and synapse assembly, lymphocyte adhesion and migration; chemokine receptor and CORO1A-DEF6 members set it apart from integrin-centred confusables.

name: Keratinocyte proliferation, differentiation and migration in wound re-epithelialisation
rationale: Members regulate keratinocyte/epithelial proliferation, differentiation, apoptosis and migration in wound healing; the confusables carry cornification/barrier or inflammatory wound members instead.

name: Fructose catabolism and glucuronate-xylulose pentose metabolism
rationale: Members are fructose catabolism disorders and glucuronate-to-xylulose-5-phosphate pentose metabolism; confusables carry galactose or pentose-phosphate shunt members.

name: Taste and olfactory chemosensory perception
rationale: All members concern perception of taste modalities or odorants/pheromones and their receptors; the confusables carry olfactory development or TRP/pH-sensing members instead.

name: CNS myelination and oligodendrocyte differentiation with glial proliferation
rationale: Members concern CNS myelin formation/maintenance, oligodendrocyte progenitor proliferation and differentiation and glial proliferation; confusables add PNS/Schwann myelination, axon regrowth or astrocyte members.

name: Non-canonical WNT5A-calcium signalling and blood-retinal barrier formation
rationale: Members are WNT5A/Frizzled internalisation and Wnt/Ca2+ signalling with retinal vessel and blood-brain/retinal barrier establishment; confusables carry Wnt secretion or lens/eye development instead.

name: Ubiquitin chain editing and proteasomal protein turnover
rationale: Nearly all members concern E1/E2/E3 ubiquitination, linkage-specific deubiquitinases and proteasome function (two BTM modules are only loosely tied); confusables carry autophagy/ERAD or neddylation members instead.

core: Nucleotide-sugar transport and sialic acid metabolism
name: Golgi nucleotide-sugar and sulfate transporters and sialic acid metabolism
rationale: Members are SLC35/SLC26A2/SLC33A1 transporter defects supplying glycosylation substrates plus sialic acid and amino sugar metabolism; confusables carry UDP-GlcNAc synthesis, GPI or N-glycan members.

name: Isoprenoid quinone synthesis and vitamin K-dependent gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members are mevalonate isoprenoid synthesis feeding ubiquinone and vitamin K metabolism plus gamma-carboxylation of protein precursors; confusables carry cholesterol, vitamin D or vitamin E members.

name: Phagocyte NADPH oxidase respiratory burst and neutrophil bacterial killing
rationale: Members concern NADPH oxidase ROS generation, respiratory burst regulation and neutrophil degranulation and bacterial killing; confusables carry hyperoxia, toxin uptake or CD163 members.

name: Small RNA methylation and snRNP/snoRNP biogenesis
rationale: Members are rRNA/tRNA/snRNA methylation and cap hypermethylation with snRNP/snoRNP assembly and Cajal body localisation; confusables carry pseudouridylation or diphthamide members instead.
